mechanism.active_tokens: ordinary gathered FFN forward and backward
mechanism.inactive_tokens: one shared FFN(0) per layer, broadcast without per-token FFN matmuls
mechanism.null_learning: ordinary autograd through the shared null output aggregates inactive-token gradients into its FFN parameters
mechanism.allocation: frozen low_max_abs versus exact-budget random with the identical null-state mechanism
mechanism.deployment: sparse active-token FFN plus shared null-state output at inference
mechanism.dropout: active rows use ordinary per-row dropout; the single null row uses one shared dropout mask per layer during training and no dropout during evaluation

validation.reference: explicit gathered active FFN plus shared null FFN with ordinary autograd, non-square batch and sequence dimensions, padding, zero dropout

full_cost_accounting.null_cost_explanation: four forward and six backward matrix-multiply equivalents for the single null row; its input requires no gradient
full_cost_accounting.auxiliary_operations: realized scoring, gather/scatter, null output broadcast, and inactive-gradient reduction estimates added separately
full_cost_accounting.evaluation: retained separately from training cost for every arm
full_cost_accounting.mps_visible_counters: diagnostics only; standard backward is undercounted on MPS

dense_fewer_quality_reference: results-program/level3-75/body6/dense-fewer_seed9406.json; identical body, online data stream, and newly generated held-out data; quality only, with cost recomputed from the CPU-calibrated dense step
primary_endpoint: sparse null-state held-out loss of low_max_abs_null versus random_null and ordinary dense-fewer at matched full training cost
exact_cost_rule: use the lower of the two final costs; keep the lower-cost arm at its final evaluation and linearly interpolate the other arm between its bracketing evaluations; also report both unadjusted final endpoints
secondary_endpoints: ordinary dense-body held-out loss and accuracy
sparse null-state accuracy and full trajectory

decision_rules.no_level_3: low_max_abs_null beats random_null but not dense-fewer; stop
decision_rules.development_level_3: low_max_abs_null beats random_null and dense-fewer at exact matched cost
decision_rules.confirmation: only development_level_3 launches the identical body-7 comparison

prohibited: using ordinary dense-body loss as the primary sparse-deployment endpoint
computing per-token FFN matmuls for inactive tokens
omitting null forward/backward or auxiliary costs
using MPS-only totals as full costs
changing the mechanism, activity, steps, or evaluation after launch
launching body 7 without a development-level dense-fewer win
